implemented_capabilities: Bounded UTF-8 text reads with one-based line ranges
Streaming whole-file SHA-256 revision digest without whole-file buffering
Explicit EOF, truncation, continuation, line-count, size, and returned-byte metadata
Batch reads with a shared byte budget and independent per-item errors
Structured stable error codes for initial file-read failure classes
remaining_debt: No performance benchmark exists yet against Desktop Commander or direct shell reads
search_text and repo_snapshot are not implemented
mutation and revision-bound patch semantics are not implemented
durable job handles and output cursors are not implemented
MCP and Hermes integration are not implemented
No runtime ObservedEvent or comparator receipt is emitted by ordivon-exec yet

authorization.rationale: This bootstrap does not authorize deployment, remote exposure, filesystem mutation, shell execution, or replacement of the legacy bridge.
